page.overview:
Who is Momma Fly?

The Momma Fly makes a brief appearance in A Bug's Life.

"When Francis takes on the two flies who've called him a cutie, he upsets a momma fly sitting nearby with her little ones. As the babies bawl, Slim tries to calm his pal down. "Come on Francis, you're making the maggots cry.""

In the film, she is seen trying to quiet her maggot babies down when they start wailing, due to Francis' loud arguing. She is not seen again throughout the rest of the entire film.
